deploybot: Release paused: environment parity check failed: keystore.metadata.epoch mismatch (staging: 1690001200, prod: 1690004800). Blocking step: key-rotation validation. Release placed on hold in current change window.

emma.eng: I triggered the same preflight locally. metadata.epoch differs but key fingerprints match. looks like only the metadata timestamp moved when prod backfill ran yesterday.

jorge.ops: yep, prod backfill ran during a maintenance job; staging didn't get the propagation.

ops-oncall: deploybot error: `keystore validation: epoch mismatch -> aborting rotation` (logs id: rb-2812345678).

release-coordinator: options: 1) copy prod metadata down to staging (fast, needs S3 write + audit), 2) roll the release to wait for scheduled parity job (delay ~3h), 3) abort and rollback canary artifacts. What's risk appetite?

security-bot: note: any direct write to staging keystore will trigger KMS audit and S3 event to compliance. Tagging security@.

emma.eng: leaning to a targeted metadata sync. we'll snapshot staging keystore first, then patch only the metadata. commands I propose: 
```
# snapshot
aws s3 cp s3://keystore/staging/keystore.json /tmp/keystore.staging.snapshot.json
# create patched copy from prod but keep keys identical
aws s3 cp s3://keystore/prod/keystore.json - | jq '.metadata |= {epoch: .epoch, tz: .tz} | .metadata.epoch = 1690004800' > /tmp/keystore.staging.patched.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/keystore.staging.patched.json s3://keystore/staging/keystore.json --sse aws:kms
```
Make sure to include an audit note.

jorge.ops: will run snapshot+patch from bastion, record stdout/stderr to s3://keystore/audit/2812345678/ . I can also create a short maint ticket in #incidents for traceability.

ops-oncall: please add a release note line: "Applied metadata parity patch to staging to satisfy deploy validations; key material unchanged."

release-coordinator: decision: perform controlled metadata sync. also pin the inference engine to inference-engine@v1.12.0 for this rollout to avoid additional runtime changes. resume plan: after patch, run full deploybot preflight and smoke tests, then proceed with 5% canary.

emma.eng: doing snapshot now.

security-bot: Reminder: include CMK alias and access justification in audit comment.

jorge.ops: patched and uploaded; snapshot saved at /tmp/keystore.staging.snapshot.json; audit log at s3://keystore/audit/2812345678/patch.log. Command exit 0.

deploybot: Re-running validations for thread 2812345678...

deploybot: Preflight checks OK. Proceeding with rollout (canary 5%).

emma.eng: monitoring canary metrics. latency and errors normal so far. :eyes:

ops-oncall: keeping a 2-hour watch on rotation jobs and keystore sync tasks. will escalate if any discrepancy surfaces.

release-coordinator: created follow-up issue to harden epoch reconciliation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4734. Will include note in release notes and ops runbook.

emma.eng: small suggestion for deploybot: allow a configurable tolerance window (e.g., 600s) for metadata-only epoch skew. I'll draft a PR.

release-coordinator: resolved for now. marking thread closed once doc updated in release notes. :white_check_mark:
